changelog: fix: the remaining [WARN] lines from the 2.9.29 render log. These were not re-render problems: the same lines are in a normal run's pipeline.log, and each one is a figure or table that has never been produced. (1) Faith's PD: picante needs a rooted tree; the pipeline's tree is unrooted, so it is now midpoint-rooted (phangorn, else rooted on the first tip). (2) UniFrac PCoA/NMDS (20a-d) ran on ps, which carries no tree by design, so 'phy_tree slot is empty' four times; they now use ps_tree (midpoint-rooted if needed). (3) Metastats: the same per-taxon rbind failure as STAMP ('names do not match previous names'); now built column by column, names split across lineages summed. (4) ClusterTree+Bar (12b) called ggdendro::geom_segment/geom_text, which do not exist; they are ggplot2's. (5) DESeq2 heatmap stopped on duplicate row names ('Unclassified' twice); the labels are made unique. (6) LEfSe: lefser renamed groupCol to classCol; the old name was ignored and lefser looked for a column called GROUP. The argument name is now chosen from the installed lefser, unused group levels dropped, and newer output ('features') accepted. (7) Rank abundance (03c): rebuilt without the per-sample rbind, and the warning now names the failing call if it still fails. (8) STAMP subtitle no longer runs off the right edge: the small-sample note is on its own line and the title block starts at the figure edge. Left as is: FUNGuildR is for ITS (fungi) and is not used for 16S. Verified in R where the container allows (rank abundance and Metastats blocks on the U2BI-139 tables); viz_pipeline.R parses. Not verifiable here without phyloseq/picante/lefser/DESeq2: those are checked by the next render's log.

previous.changelog: polish: STAMP error bars stop at 100% and the figure states its method and sample size. With 2 samples per group mean + 1.96 SE ran past 100% (Bacillota in feed reached ~140%), which no relative abundance can. The subtitle now reads 'Top 25 by abundance · mean ± 1.96 SE · n = 2 vs 2 · * = q < 0.05' and adds 'too few samples per group for a reliable test' below 3 per group. Checked against the 2.9.28 render: 49 figures, nothing missing; both 17_beta_heatmap figures and the three 19_stamp figures drawn; volcano reads 'Reactor vs feed'.
